Tie-break building blocks

record_vs.Rd

The pieces of the official NBA tie-break procedure. Teams are identified by their abbreviations. scores_tidy has one row per team per game: team_slug, opponent_slug, score, and opponent_score.

Usage

record_vs(team_abbr, opponent_abbrs, scores_tidy)

point_differential(team_abbr, scores_tidy)

get_division_leaders(conf_standings, scores_tidy, meta)

break_two_team_tie(
  t1,
  t2,
  standings_df,
  scores_tidy,
  meta,
  division_leaders = character(0),
  playoff_eligible_own = NULL,
  playoff_eligible_other = NULL
)

break_multi_team_tie(
  team_abbrs,
  standings_df,
  scores_tidy,
  meta,
  division_leaders = character(0),
  playoff_eligible_own = NULL,
  playoff_eligible_other = NULL
)

Arguments

team_abbr, t1, t2

Team abbreviations.

opponent_abbrs

Abbreviations of the opponents to count games against.

scores_tidy

One row per team per game.

conf_standings

Standings for one conference: abbreviation, division, Winning Pct.

meta

Team details: abbreviation, conference, division.

standings_df

Not used; kept so the call signature matches the seeding code.

division_leaders

Abbreviations of the division leaders.

playoff_eligible_own, playoff_eligible_other

Abbreviations of the teams in playoff position in the team's own and the other conference. NULL skips the criterion.

team_abbrs

Abbreviations of three or more tied teams.

Value

record_vs() returns a one-row tibble with wins, losses, and pct (missing when no games were played). point_differential() returns the net points over all of a team's games. get_division_leaders() returns one abbreviation per division. break_two_team_tie() returns c(winner, loser). break_multi_team_tie() returns the teams in order. Criteria are applied in the official order; if nothing separates the teams they are ordered alphabetically, standing in for the random draw.

Examples

with(seeding_example, {
  record_vs("W2", c("W1", "W3"), scores_tidy)
  point_differential("W2", scores_tidy)
  break_two_team_tie("W1", "W2", NULL, scores_tidy, meta)
  break_multi_team_tie(c("A1", "A2", "A3"), NULL, scores_tidy, meta)
})
#> [1] "A3" "A1" "A2"
